metadata.description: Captured POST /api/mdm/profiles/uploadcertificate on the 26.4 lab tenant (UEM 26.4), 2026-09-24, Upload a genuinely valid self-signed synthetic PKCS#12 certificate (RSA 2048, openssl-generated, disposable test key/password); no DELETE endpoint exists for a standalone uploaded certificate anywhere in mdm v1-v4 swagger, so this cannot be cleaned up via the API -- same accepted known limitation as the prior port. Genuine 26.4 recapture replacing the PORTED-FROM-26.2 fixture at this path. DISCLOSURE: the uploaded request payload is a synthetic PKCS#12 certificate generated for the capture; the response is the real 26.4 server reply.
